correctness.rationale: For characteristic p>=5, the Segre cubic has ten nodes indexed by unordered 3+3 partitions N and 15 planes indexed by perfect matchings M. Blowing up ten nodes yields smooth Y isomorphic to compactified M_{0,6}. Keel’s Picard presentation has 25 boundary generators and 9 independent relations; the 15 plane classes plus the invariant sum of exceptional classes give the full 16-dimensional rational Picard representation with trace 1+fixed(M). Hard Lefschetz and Poincaré duality produce equal characters on H2 and H4 and point count Y=1+q^{3s}+(1+fixed(M^{sigma^s}))(q^s+q^{2s}). Replacing each exceptional quadric by its node subtracts fixed(N) q^{2s}+fixed(R) q^s, where R indexes the two individual tangent-quadric rulings per node and accounts for non-split quadrics. This yields the exact all-s extension-count formula and the zeta Euler-product factors. Fresh independent combinatorial enumeration of 15 matchings, 10 nodes and 20 rulings reconstructed all 11 conjugacy profiles; separately direct F5^d trace-equation enumeration for degrees d<=6 verified all 11 twisted F5 point counts (256,146,176,226,121,131,211,186,136,156,151), not just the untwisted case. Finite q=5 checks corroborate the cited geometry; the all-prime-power statement rests on the blowup/Picard trace argument.

originality.rationale: Prior Dolgachev (2015) describes Segre cubic equations, ten nodes/fifteen planes and moduli resolution; Carr/Keel provides Picard relations; Avilov (2018) classifies forms and geometric Galois actions. These foundations are credited. The all-eleven Frobenius class point counts AND entire extension-field zeta products, including individual-ruling splitting correction, are not established by the inspected primary statements. Search for dominating equivariant M0,6 motives or precomputed zeta tables found no explicit equivalent, but such prior formulations remain a priority risk. Resultary found other finite-field classifications, not Segre cubic zeta for eleven classes.
residual_risks: A pre-existing equivariant motive or zeta-function formula for \bar M_{0,6} plus nodal correction could imply the whole result under a change of presentation.
The S6 outer-automorphism convention for coordinate action versus moduli action must be preserved exactly; swapping them corrupts the class table.
The finite-field direct check covers q=5, not arbitrary p; uniform correctness rests on characteristic>=5 geometry and cohomological descent.
